answer.explanation: In the window, the Uploader fails on every invocation (389 errors) with NoSuchBucket on s3:PutObject, and the error text is NoSuchBucket, not AccessDenied, so this is not an IAM issue. The same error has been present since 2026-10-18 21:22, so it is a persistent misconfiguration rather than a new change inside the window. The bucket name the function uses appears to point to a bucket that does not exist. The likeliest location is the OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable (CONFIG). The IaC template is the next candidate if it hard-codes the wrong name. The other three functions show no errors in the window. Limitation: I could not read the function configuration, IaC template or code directly with the available tools, so the artifact ranking relies on the error signature rather than on inspecting those sources.
